about: Pinned translator-vs-native differences over the repository's .pl sources (clausal.tools.pl_parity; tests/test_pl_parity.py). Classes: a translator bug (native agrees with the oracle), b native gap, c both wrong, d intentional by a ruling. Measured 2026-10-12.

known.note: oracle: scryer loads it, as native does. Translator: Cannot import <root>/clausal/tools/prolog_preludes/clausal_constants_trealla.pl: line 39: Prolog functor ':' cannot be translated to a Clausal predicate name (':' is not a valid Pytho

native refuses the WHOLE file at the one grammar rule that has \+ in its body (dcg_grammar.pl:31, representation_error(dcg_body)), as Scryer refuses that rule; Scryer and Trealla still load the rest of the file, the translator accepts all of it. Classed (a) because native's reading of the rule is Scryer's (ISO first, then Scryer, ruling 2026-09-27); refusing the whole file rather than the one clause is the slice 0 fail-closed rule
